status: Jobs first-render cache and Notifications metadata-first loading verified against current source callbacks; native full-app UI acceptance is a separate gate.
changes: Jobs initializes the default list, application/saved state and poster logos from the current session cache before its first render.
Jobs restores cached scope/sort snapshots before paint and invalidates outgoing refreshes; an uncached filter failure does not present the previous filter rows as the new selection.
Notifications publishes authorized textual metadata with private media removed, then hydrates row media and thumbnails independently in the background.

Delayed first-page media updates preserve appended notification pages and newer read/invitation edits; generation and navigation-session checks suppress late publication including same-user A-to-B-to-A transitions.
Activity refresh/media errors retain the visible list and expose an inline retry. Periodic media renewal failure removes unchanged private capabilities without discarding activity text.

Invitation cleanup follows invitation identity rather than list length, skips photo-only changes, and never treats a failed/malformed collaborator lookup as proof that invitations should be removed. Cleanup is session/generation guarded and deletion is filtered to its recipient.

observations.scenario: Notifications metadata response with both media paths deliberately unresolved
observations.observed: One usable notification and SectionList are published, loading=false, before signing/thumbnails settle. No unverified private media URL is exposed.

observations.scenario: 60 notification rows, first-page signing held, next page completed
observations.observed: All 61 rows remain after the older media response resolves; no page truncation.

observations.scenario: Warm Jobs remount with scoped snapshot, network work held
observations.observed: First render contains cached jobs, save/application state and poster logos; loading=false.

observations.scenario: Switch back to cached Jobs filter with outgoing request held
observations.observed: Correct cached filter snapshot is restored in the layout effect and old request cannot overwrite it.

startupAudit: App loads fonts independently of auth. Its QueryClient uses staleTime=30000, gcTime=300000, retry=1, refetchOnWindowFocus=false, and cancels/clears on navigation account-scope changes.
The previous 450 ms useAfterTransition gate is removed. Main tabs retain mounted content with detachInactiveScreens=false and unmountOnBlur=false.
Market, Channels and Trends already initialize their scoped cache before render. No additional cache redesign was needed for those screens.
limits: The Jobs/Notifications tests compile production screen callbacks and render branches with controlled data/state adapters. They do not measure native pixels, frames, touch latency or live Supabase request duration.
The held-promise tests prove removal of media and network gating for the named states. Test-run wall-clock duration is not a device performance claim.
Notifications still refreshes its first metadata page on focus; this follow-up does not claim complete offscreen pagination retention or a persistent notification cache.
Existing public web frame continuity measurements are recorded separately in resumed-warm-navigation-frames.json and use a component/browser fixture, not production Next routing.
No authStore/call-service edits were made by this follow-up. Source hashes bind the four scoped files; other workstreams changed different files concurrently.
